intro: Every venue the 2026-11-17 run called 'wrong shape' or 'off', checked by eye on `cache/overview_small.jpg` after candidate selection was fixed (see `Docs/Track-Reference.md` - Reading the verdict). 'Wrong' says which side is at fault: the game's track, or the reference candidate the 2026-11-17 run measured it against. Candidate numbers are the ones in each venue's current `report.md`; `--write-trace=<#>` takes them. No track has been changed. In all eleven the game's line is wrong; in five the old reference was wrong too (a chain through a pit lane or another circuit's roads), and two committed traces (Atlanta, Kansas) are such chains and must be replaced, not imported.

Atlanta.from: #0 (OSM way 288853230, the oval itself, -2.6%); pit way 288853232
Atlanta.why: Game is the generic stadium oval (1035 x 382 m) on a wider quad-oval (about 950 x 510 m); 46.5 m RMS. The committed trace Assets/TrackTraces/Atlanta.json (old best) is not the oval: it runs 15% down Pit Road and through the AMS Small Oval and turns 118 deg against the lap - why the importer refused it. Replace it with #0, do not import the old one. Rebuilt 2026-11-18 from #0 (--write-trace=0 --start=apex --pit=288853232): imported, package redressed, line retrained; now matches at 1.4 m RMS (p95 2.3, max 2.5).

COTA.wrong: game (old reference ran down the pit lane)
COTA.from: #0 (Grand Prix circuit, raceway only, +0.27%), now Assets/TrackTraces/COTA.json (--write-trace=0 --start=30.13205,-97.63985); pit way 514836373
COTA.why: Game's hand-authored RoadCourseLayouts line is a loose sketch, 68 m RMS, most corners in the wrong place. The old best (-0.01%) took the 948 m Pit Lane way instead of the front straight; the new #0 sits on the circuit all the way round. NASCAR has raced the 2.4 mi National-style layout since 2025 - the game's 3.41 mi GP lap is a TrackDimensions decision, not a geometry one. Rebuilt 2026-11-20 as far as a lane without the Editor can. OSM has no start/finish node here, so the line is an estimate: mid front straight, level with the middle of the straight run of the mapped Pit Lane. Counter-clockwise, as raced. The importer's road-course path (OsmTrackGeometry.SegmentTrace, 24 m window) had been lost from develop - OsmTrackImporter called it and the Editor assembly did not compile - and is restored. Read headless (TracedOvalImportTests, the importer's own Core path): closes within the 3% gate, rescaled to 3.41 mi, and the built lap lies 2.5 m RMS off the trace - 'matches' once imported (IndyRoad, imported, reads 1.9 m the same way and measured 1.8 m exported). The mapped Pit Lane fits as pit road beside the front straight (743 m: S-bends r60, 629 m straight 12.9 m off the line, ends 0.6 / 7.3 m from the mapped ones). An AI lap of the built shape on the RacingLineTrainer model (SplineDriver's speed profile) gets round: centreline 117.6 s, trained 108.0 s, slowest point 64 mph. Width 15 m and banking 0 still from TrackDimensions. The stale trained line (5488 m, the same length, so it would have been accepted on the new shape) is deleted. Still to do in Unity: Import Traced Geometry (selected asset) on COTA only, Export Geometry For Paddock Layout (Selected Track), re-run this report, redress walls/ground (generated dressing only; scatter, paddock via paddock_generate.py --regenerate), retrain the line, run the COTA track tests and a lap sim in Unity.

Charlotte.from: #0 (Charlotte Motor Speedway oval ways, -2.1%), now Assets/TrackTraces/Charlotte.json (--start=apex); pit ways 116034339,401660631,1052107105,401660628 (668 m, the whole front-stretch pit road)
Charlotte.why: Game is a narrow generic oval (1021 x 351 m) on a wide 1.5 mi quad-oval; 42.8 m RMS. The reference was right (the same ring as before; OSM draws it a little inside the groove, which the importer's rescale to the published lap absorbs). The Roval-chicane chains now rank below it. Rebuilt 2026-11-18 as far as a lane without the Editor can: the trace imports headlessly (TracedOvalImportTests, the importer's own Core path) closing to 3 m (0.13% of the lap, limit 3%) in 46 constant-curvature pieces, and that lap lies 0.6-1.0 m RMS off the trace - 'matches' once imported; the mapped pit lane fits as an 820 m pit road (r160 arcs, 601 m straight). The same reading predicts Daytona's real import to 0.1 m and its pit road exactly. The stale trained line (fitted to the generic oval, same lap length so it would have been accepted) is deleted. Still to do in Unity: Import Traced Geometry (selected asset) on Charlotte only, Export Geometry For Paddock Layout (Selected Track), re-run this report, redress walls/ground/stands, retrain the line, run the Charlotte track tests and a lap sim.

CharlotteRoval.wrong: game (old reference was an oval-and-Roval chain)
CharlotteRoval.why: Game line leaves the venue entirely - loops through the car parks north and south of the speedway; 107.6 m RMS. The old best (-3.19%) came from the straight-on walker, which cannot turn off the oval where the Roval does; the junction search finds the Roval proper. #0 includes both the frontstretch and backstretch chicanes; check the infield against the 2024 layout on the Unity aerial overlay before writing the trace (no diagram on Commons).

Darlington.from: #0 (OSM way 104277971, the raceway ring, -4.5%); pit = front-stretch run of way 918351834
Darlington.why: Game is a symmetric oval (817 x 513 m) spilling outside the walls at both ends; the real egg is 843 x 393 m; 38.2 m RMS with the fit's scale pinned at its 0.95 limit. The trace is on the racing surface (drawn toward the inside, hence -4.5%) and README says it imported, yet the export is not that shape: either the package was regenerated afterwards or Tools/TrackExports/Darlington.json is stale. Re-export first; if still off, re-run Import Traced Geometry. 2026-11-18: the 4-segment asset is the old importer's one-arc-per-end reading of this same ring (two equal 323 m straights, 173/187 deg arcs) - the import did happen, it just could not describe an egg. Trace rewritten from #0 for the curvature importer (--write-trace=0 --start=34.293796,-79.905565, start/finish an estimate mid front stretch; pitLane trimmed to the way's front-stretch nodes 20-27, since the whole way wraps both turn aprons). Replaying OsmTrackImporter headless: 24 pieces, closes 1.2 m (0.06%), predicted 1.8 m RMS (p95 2.4, max 2.5) = matches; mapped pit road fits (853 m, straight 616 m against the published ~2,025 ft, entry Turn 4, exit Turn 1). Still needs a Unity lane: Import Traced Geometry (Darlington only), redress, re-export, retrain the line.

Indianapolis.from: #0 (IMS oval's named ways: main straight, turns 1-4, short chutes, backstretch, +1.2%)
Indianapolis.why: Game is a long thin stadium (1807 x 360 m); the real oval is a rounded rectangle (about 1.4 x 0.8 km) with short chutes; 150 m RMS. Not a tool artefact: #0 is a clean ring of the oval's own ways, and the outer-wall offset #1 gives the same fit (150.6 m).

IndyRoad.wrong: game (old reference was a backstretch-and-pit-lane chain)
IndyRoad.from: the old #1 (OSM's 'IMS Road Course' ring, -0.44%), now the committed trace (#0)
IndyRoad.why: Game line wandered far outside the speedway; 163 m RMS. The old best (+0.99%) was the oval's backstretch chained through the warm-up lane and pit lanes; the new candidates are real road-course laps. The old #0 (+0.00%) runs OSM's 'Alternate Corner 1 Entry' and 'Alternate Corners 12 & 12A'; the old #1 is 93% on ways named plain 'IMS Road Course' (the 2014-present Grand Prix course) and reads as exactly 14 corners. Rebuilt 2026-11-19 from #1: --write-trace=1 --start=39.7931571,-86.2388466 (OSM's 'IMS Start-Finish Line' on the bricks) --pit=588780329,1176980820 (F1 pit lane + IMS Pit Lane) --clockwise (OSM tags road_course=clockwise; the importer used to force every trace counter-clockwise, which would have run the course backwards). Read at a road-course curvature window (24 m; the oval 117 m rounded the hairpins to 13 m RMS): 80 pieces, 14 corners, closed 5 m -> 0, rescaled to 2.439 mi; width 15 m and banking 0 still from TrackDimensions. Pit road beside the front stretch on the mapped lane (S-bends r120, 701 m straight 19.7 m off the line, ends within 0.7 m of the mapped ones). Package re-laid (road, ground, walls, 12 stands, scenery); the hand-only paddock left as it was. Line retrained from scratch. Now matches at 1.8 m RMS (p95 3.4, max 5.5); the old #0 (alternate corners) reads 9.8 m against it.

Kansas.from: #1 (OSM way 37552701, Kansas Speedway, +2.6%) - or #0, the outer fence offset 8.4 m in, which agrees
Kansas.why: Game is a narrow oval (1022 x 345 m) on a 1.5 mi tri-oval about 950 x 460 m; 70 m RMS against the real ring. The committed trace (old best, +0.24%) runs 34% down the pit lane - the importer refused it; replace it with #1. Rebuilt 2026-11-18 from the raceway ring (way 37552701; candidate #2 in that run's ranking, --write-trace=2 --start=apex --pit=42240617): imported, package redressed, line retrained; now matches at 0.5 m RMS (p95 0.8, max 1.1), and 0.7 m against the outer-fence ring as an independent check.

LimeRock.from: #0 (Climbing Turn layout, +0.02%), now Assets/TrackTraces/LimeRock.json (start/finish = first node on the front straight; pit = way 35341695); #1 is the South Chicane variant (-1.9%)
LimeRock.why: Game line followed the west side then left the property north and south; 46.7 m RMS. Reference right: #0 runs on the circuit all round. Wikipedia's full course is 1.53 mi; #0 (no chicane) is 1.498 mi, which is the 1.5 mi / 7 turns TrackDimensions already has, so the length stays. Rebuilt 2026-11-20 from #0 (raced clockwise): read at the road-course curvature window, 70 pieces, closed 2.6 m -> 0, rescaled to 1.5 mi; width 11 m and banking still from TrackDimensions. Pit road on the mapped lane (798 m, r200 arcs, 540 m straight). Package re-dressed (road, ground, walls, paddock + RV; the 5 generated grandstands Dress added were removed - scatter only), scenery re-scattered, geometry re-exported, paddock sidecar regenerated (validator clean). Line retrained from scratch (68.20 -> 66.62 s). Now matches at 1.4 m RMS (p95 2.7, max 4.7); the chicane ring #1 reads 6.7 m against it. AI lap sim (AILapSimTests.AnAICarLapsLimeRockCleanly, pace 1.12/1.25 x line -0.05/0.08, 3 laps): 50.9-51.2 s, 0 incidents.

MexicoCity.from: #0 (committed OSM trace round the 2015-present GP circuit through the Foro Sol), rewritten as Assets/TrackTraces/MexicoCity.json (--write-trace=0 --clockwise --start=19.4062874,-99.0949202 --pit=638504647,772763791), back-straight detour removed
MexicoCity.why: Game line is a loose sketch; 121 m RMS. No NAIP imagery (outside the US), but the trace (94% on ways OSM names Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez) follows the 2015-present layout through the stadium; checked by eye against the Wikipedia 2015 diagram (T1-3 at the east end, T4-6 hairpin south, esses 7-11, back straight, T12 north into the Foro Sol, 13-16, T17 onto the main straight). The old file was a pre-curvature batch trace the importer refused on its 3% closure check. Rewritten 2026-11-20 as far as a lane without the Editor can: clockwise as raced, start/finish an ESTIMATE on the main straight about 190 m east of the westmost point (level with the line on the Wikipedia diagram; OSM marks none), pit lane = the mapped Pit Lane ways 638504647+772763791 (795 m along the inside of the main straight). Candidate #0 (and #1) also detours 33 m off the back straight round unnamed raceway way 1128592397 (an access loop, not the circuit; the named way 1128592398 runs straight past it): those 118 m were replaced by the 88 m straight, which takes the lap from +1.02% to +0.05% of the published 2.67 mi. Read headless (TracedOvalImportTests, the importer's own Core path): closes within the 3% gate, rescaled to the published lap, and the built lap lies 2.1 m RMS off the trace - 'matches' once imported. The mapped Pit Lane fits as pit road beside the main straight (797 m: S-bends r60, 674 m straight 13.3 m off the line, ends 0.1 / 0.1 m from the mapped ones; the +-800 m window lays over at 7.6 m, under the 8 m road-course limit). An AI lap of the built shape on the RacingLineTrainer model gets round: centreline 91.6 s, trained 85.7 s (112 mph average), slowest point 56 mph in the stadium. Width 15 m and banking 0 still from TrackDimensions. The stale trained line (4303 m, the same length, so it would have been accepted on the new shape) is deleted. Still to do in Unity: Import Traced Geometry (selected asset) on MexicoCity only, Export Geometry For Paddock Layout (Selected Track), re-run this report, redress walls/ground (generated dressing only - keep any hand-authored pieces; scatter, paddock via paddock_generate.py --regenerate), retrain the line, run the MexicoCity track tests and an AI lap sim in Unity.

IRP.from: #0 (OSM way 123830268, Lucas Oil Raceway, -4.5%), now Assets/TrackTraces/IRP.json (--start=39.812369,-86.341805); pit = front-stretch run of way 531132316 (nodes 1-9)
IRP.why: Game is a long thin oval (464 x 156 m) on a wider, rounder 0.686 mi oval; 24.5 m RMS. The OSM ring sits on the racing surface toward the inside line (hence -4.5%; the importer rescales to the lap). 2026-11-18: checked on NAIP, the ring runs on the racing surface all round. Trace written from #0 for the curvature importer (start/finish an ESTIMATE mid front stretch by the grandstands; pitLane trimmed to the way's front-stretch nodes 1-9, since the whole way wraps the Turn 1 and Turn 3-4 aprons onto the backstretch and its ends lay no pit road). Replaying OsmTrackImporter headless (the importer's Core path, as TracedOvalImportTests does): 32 pieces, closes 0.47 m before the solve (0.04% of the lap, limit 3%), rescaled to the 1104 m lap; built lap 0.48 m RMS off the trace and predicted 0.43 m RMS (p95 0.67, max 1.23, scale x0.959) against this reference = matches; mapped pit road fits (438 m, r40 arcs, straight 338 m, entry 253 m before the line, exit 231 m after). The stale trained line (old shape, same 1104 m lap, so it would have been accepted) is deleted. Still needs a Unity lane: Import Traced Geometry (IRP only), Export Geometry For Paddock Layout, re-run this report, redress walls/ground/stands (package is fully generated - scenery scatter only), regenerate the paddock sidecar, retrain the line, run the IRP track tests and a lap sim.

Dover.why: Close: 4.2 m RMS - the old importer read each end of the 51-node ring as one arc. Rebuilt 2026-11-22 (close -> matches): same OSM ring re-read as constant-curvature runs (--write-trace=0 --start=<the game's existing start/finish>), imported into the asset only, package re-dressed (TrackDressingFactory overwrite: ground, walls, grandstands, paddock) and re-scattered, geometry re-exported, paddock sidecar regenerated (8 variants), racing line retrained from scratch. No --pit: the mapped Pit Road (395874675) is on the real front stretch, the game's line and pit road are on the back stretch. First import hit a near-singular straights-only closure (0.4 m gap -> both straights +286 m, 30 m RMS); LapGeometry.CloseByStraights now refuses a correction over 5 m + 10x the gap. Now 0.6 m RMS (p95 0.9, max 1.2); 3.9 m against #1 (ring + pit road).

Rebuilt 2026-11-22 (close -> matches): same OSM ring re-read as constant-curvature runs (--write-trace=0 --start=<the game's existing start/finish>), imported into the asset only, package re-dressed (TrackDressingFactory overwrite: ground, walls, grandstands, paddock) and re-scattered, geometry re-exported, paddock sidecar regenerated (8 variants), racing line retrained from scratch. Rebuilt 2026-11-22 (close -> matches): same OSM ring re-read as constant-curvature runs (--write-trace=0 --start=<the game's existing start/finish>), imported into the asset only, package re-dressed (TrackDressingFactory overwrite: ground, walls, grandstands, paddock) and re-scattered, geometry re-exported, paddock sidecar regenerated (8 variants), racing line retrained from scratch. --pit=563465040: the mapped Pit Lane is on the front straight with the line; pit road refitted on it (795 m, r250 arcs, entry 130 m / exit 925 m past the line; was 0-810 m).
